ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This figure is a skeletal transition-state structure, with curved arrows; according to the problem statement, ignore all curved arrows and read only the atom connections. The central skeleton is a substituted alkene: the right alkene carbon is connected to CO2H and a phenyl group, and the left alkene carbon is connected to a benzene ring. The left benzene ring is also connected at the ortho position to an azo-hydroxonium chain, shown as Ar-N=N-OH2+. Reasoning: After ignoring the arrows, the main skeleton can be written as HO2C-C(=C-aryl)-phenyl. The left aryl needs to bear an ortho N=N-[OH2+] substituent, so this part can be written as C/c1ccccc1/N=N/[OH2+]; the other phenyl group, as a substituent on the alkene carbon, is written as c1ccccc1. Starting the SMILES from the carboxylic acid carbonyl as O=C(O), connecting to the alkene carbon and preserving the double-bond geometric slashes in the figure, gives O=C(O)/C(=C/c1ccccc1/N=N/[OH2+])c1ccccc1.

raw_record.question_text: What is the SMILES expression of the transition-state structure shown in the image, ignoring the arrows?

method.method_draft: First describe the image as a skeletal transition-state drawing, ignoring all curved arrows. Identify the main skeleton as a carboxy-substituted alkene: CO2H-C(=C-aryl)-aryl. Then read the substituents: the alkene carbon next to CO2H also bears a phenyl group, and the opposite alkene carbon is bonded to a phenyl ring that is further substituted by an azo-hydroxonium chain, Ar-N=N-[OH2+]. Convert this molecular graph into SMILES by starting at the carboxylic acid carbonyl, writing O=C(O), continuing through the alkene with stereochemical slashes, inserting the substituted aryl/azo branch, and appending the other phenyl substituent, yielding O=C(O)/C(=C/c1ccccc1/N=N/[OH2+])c1ccccc1.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：该图是一个骨架式过渡态结构，带有弯曲箭头；按题意忽略所有弯曲箭头，只读取原子连接。中心骨架是一个取代烯烃：右侧烯烃碳连有CO2H和一个苯基，左侧烯烃碳连到一个苯环。左侧苯环在邻位还连有一个偶氮-羟鎓链，表现为Ar-N=N-OH2+。推理：忽略箭头后，主骨架可写作HO2C-C(=C-aryl)-phenyl。左侧aryl需要带邻位N=N-[OH2+]取代，因此可写成C/c1ccccc1/N=N/[OH2+]这一部分；另一个苯基作为烯烃碳上的取代基写成c1ccccc1。从羧酸羰基开始写SMILES为O=C(O)，接到烯烃碳并保留图中双键几何斜线，得到O=C(O)/C(=C/c1ccccc1/N=N/[OH2+])c1ccccc1。

planner_metadata.image_role: Read the chemical drawing directly: a central C=C alkene has one carbon attached to CO2H and a phenyl ring, while the other alkene carbon is attached to a substituted phenyl ring. Preserve the drawn alkene/azo orientation using slash stereochemical notation where shown.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the prompt instruction that the desired output is the SMILES expression of the transition-state structure and that arrows in the image should be ignored.

Combine the fragments according to the skeletal connectivity to obtain O=C(O)/C(=C/c1ccccc1/N=N/[OH2+])c1ccccc1.
